title: Fifteen seconds through the cones took Darren Miles from his local park to the world championships

posts.facebook:
His tricks were fading, so Darren Miles learned to race a skateboard through cones. This month he had a place in the Great Britain team.

Darren Miles has skateboarded since he was a boy in Essex. In 2020 he switched to slalom, racing between cones, and this October he was picked to skate for Great Britain at the world championships in Asunción. How he did it, why a new skill is worth learning, and how to get on a board safely.

When one way of doing something you love starts to slip away, a different version of it can give you a new thing to get good at.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/move/darren-miles-slalom-skateboarding/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
